title: Crystal Ball Teapot Vision
description: A glowing crystal ball sits on an ornate metallic base, revealing a surreal scene inside. A crowned pink orb emits colorful energy beams connecting to floating clouds, a smiling turquoise teapot with a crown, and silhouettes of people in a green-lit interior space, with a yellow curved path swirling around the center.
prompt: A glowing purple crystal ball on a metallic steampunk base contains a surreal inner world. At the center is a pink glowing orb wearing a golden crown emitting vibrant pink, blue, and yellow energy beams that connect to white clouds, a cheerful turquoise cartoon teapot wearing a small crown, and silhouettes of people in a green architectural space. A thick yellow curved path swirls inside the sphere, whimsical fantasy style, vibrant colors, magical atmosphere.
